title: Benefits City offer object, v1
description: One offer object exactly as served by the HTTP/JSON surface (REST /api/*, MCP structuredContent, /api/bonuses.json feed) — the output of toPublic() in src/links.ts. The stored record (src/types.ts Bonus) additionally carries affiliate_url, which is NEVER served: its presence in a served object is a contract violation (additionalProperties is false and affiliate_url is deliberately undeclared). Derived from local seed-data/*.json, data/bonuses.json, and the code — no network fetch was used.
